title: Ing mumunang maniawad kapatawaran
intro: Magbalik ka keng panaun bayu ing mumunang sinlag ning aldo, bayu ya pa linakad ing ninu mang mortal keng yatu. Ing metung a pigura megawa ya ibat kareng pekamalating materyales, midinan yang istasyun babo da reng anghel, at mibili ya keng sagradung hardin a maki malino babala. Pero keng metung mung penandit, metung a pinili ing megawa — metung a mag-echo keng mabilug a amlat ning tau. ninu ya ining pigura?
clues: Mibait ku king paralan a e kalupa da ring aliwa — megawa ku ibat king alikabuk ning yatu at midinan kung mabie kaladua king kapamilatan na ning gamat ning Miglalang.
Mirinan kung belwan a malalam a pati ding anghel babo mengapamulala la kaniti.
Ing mabilug a banua inutus na ing duku la arapan ku, at ila ngan sinuku la — maliban king metung, a e bisa uli ning kayabangan.
Mibili ku keng sagradung mula, metung a lugal ning alang anggang lingap at probisyon — pero atin yang metung a mahigpit a pamagbawal.
akalingwan ku, medulas ku, at e ku memintu — at dimdam ku ing bigat ning kanakung kamalian.
Linapit ku king Ginu ku king amanung taos pusu, at tinggap na ing kanakung pamanisi, uling Ya ing Pekamapagpatawad.

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
